parsed.explanation: The dominant, documented, traveller-facing exposure is the border/document regime: passports now show sex assigned at birth, X markers ended for new issues, officers instructed to tag and refuse discrepant cases and to consider a permanent fraud-based ineligibility finding, with reported confiscations and travellers stranded, plus multiple foreign advisories. That is a state-imposed universal exposure with no working remedy (litigation pending), and immigration custody abuse of trans detainees is documented. Within the division, statutory exposure for an adult visitor is thinner: no statewide adult facility ban, no adult care ban, sodomy repealed, marriage open. But there is no state or (outside four municipalities) local public-accommodations protection and no gender-identity hate-crime enhancement, leaving service refusal with little recourse. National hate-crime coverage and partly functioning courts keep it off the 0.25 tier.
